name: Voice studio
description: Create new voices for Atena: invent one by choosing how it sounds or copy yours by reading a sentence. It works with VoiceStudio, a separate program running on this computer or on another home PC.
capabilities: Voices invented by picking pictures: woman or man, age, pitch, whisper
Copy of your voice by reading a sentence, with recorded consent
Atena speaks with the voice you choose, in over 600 languages
Transcription of audio and video from the shared folder
Audiobooks and document readings saved as audio files
One-click install on this computer or connection to another home PC
